label: PF Backlog 599
title: EDP-18: Migration/import tooling (dry-run, hashes/counts parity, dual-read, rollback snapshot, cutover flag) for control-plane/portfolio/forge/project/pipeline; JSON demoted to projections

brief.problem: Legacy JSON/SQLite stores need safe migration to new DB without data loss
brief.what_adds: Migration tooling with dry-run, parity checks, dual-read, rollback, cutover
brief.who_feels: Platform/ops + all consumers of the five domains

objective: Deliver migration/import tooling with dry-run, hash/count parity verification, dual-read, rollback snapshot and cutover flag for control-plane/portfolio/forge/project/pipeline; demote JSON stores to projections.
acceptance_criteria: Dry-run produces parity report (hashes + counts) with zero unexplained diffs
Dual-read mode verifies DB and legacy JSON agree in production traffic
Rollback snapshot restores pre-cutover state; cutover flag toggles write path safely
approach: Greenfield migration service reusing BI-PF-1309 stores; CLI entrypoints plus API endpoints for parity reporting.
verification: Parity report clean on seed dataset
risks: Large datasets may make dual-read window long
Hash parity may expose historical JSON inconsistencies
rollback: Cutover flag reverts writes to legacy JSON; snapshot restore as last resort.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Build a migration/import CLI+service layered over new Postgres stores (from BI-PF-1309): dry-run mode, hash/count parity report, dual-read flag, rollback snapshot, cutover flag. JSON stores become read-only projections served from DB.
dependency_findings: REQUIRES BI-PF-1309 (target schemas/stores) DONE before coding
RELATED BI-PF-1295 (SQLite disposition) DONE determines source datasets
conflict_findings: Overlaps BI-PF-1309 module set; sequence after it lands
duplication_findings: No existing migration tooling found; EDP-23 backup/restore (BI-PF-1315) covers snapshots but not data import
BI-PF-1295 resolves whether SQLite sources are live or fixtures
analysis.rationale: No existing code; core cutover safety for the EDP storage migration.
assumptions: Postgres target per EDP roadmap ADR (BI-PF-1293)
All five domains follow one migration pattern
risks: Large datasets may make dual-read window long
Hash parity may expose historical JSON inconsistencies
missing_info: Cutover flag scope: per-domain or global?

context_review.reason: Dependent stores (BI-PF-1309/1307) must exist before implementation.

api_impact.reason: retrofit assessment (ADR-0007): no external API consumer recorded; treated as internal until an API surface is required (then set needs_api=true with routes)
